statement: The function returns a result r such that r.len = len(nums), and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), if j is the unique integer satisfying 0 <= j < len(nums) and j ≡ i + nums[i] (mod len(nums)), then r[i] = nums[j]. This is the circular move: positive nums[i] moves right, negative nums[i] moves left, and nums[i] = 0 stays at i.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1, len(nums) <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100.
